_doc: PYLON 2026 role priors. Two purposes. (1) Rookies and role-changers have no usable play-by-play history, so their opportunity share has to be asserted rather than measured. (2) Known injuries and depth-chart decisions override what the history implies. target_share / rush_share are shares of the team's projected attempts BEFORE within-team normalisation. games is the projected availability out of 17. Every entry cites the reason. Entries carrying an availability claim have a stale_after_week: past that week the assertion is dropped and measured in-season usage takes over, because an August injury note is a statement about September and nothing else.

Jeremiyah Love.why: 1.03 overall. Bell-cow role but high ankle sprain in camp and Brissett at QB caps the offense.

Jadarian Price.why: 1.32. Direct replacement for Kenneth Walker III with Charbonnet on PUP.

Carnell Tate.why: 1.04 into an empty Tennessee WR room. Daboll OC.

Jordyn Tyson.why: 1.08 but a hamstring costs roughly two months.

Makai Lemon.why: 1.20. Direct beneficiary of the A.J. Brown trade. Hamstring costs early reps.

KC Concepcion.why: 1.24 into the league's thinnest receiver room.

De'Zhaun Stribling.why: R2. Biggest ADP riser in football after Pearsall's season-ending PCL surgery.

Jonah Coleman.why: R4 but drafted three rounds ahead of ADP in expert mocks. Committee with Harvey and Dobbins.

Kenyon Sadiq.why: 1.16 into a Frank Reich offense with Geno Smith.

Kaelon Black.why: R3 insurance behind McCaffrey, who is 30 with a long injury ledger.

Fernando Mendoza.why: 1.01 but Cousins opens as starter. Priced as a midseason takeover.

Ty Simpson.why: 1.13. Pure succession pick behind a healthy Stafford.

Malik Willis.why: 3yr/$67.5M. Career high is 23 pass attempts in a game. Volume ceiling is the whole story.

Kyler Murray.why: Beat out J.J. McCarthy on a vet-minimum deal.

Tua Tagovailoa.why: Vet minimum. Durability history is the projection risk.

Deshaun Watson.why: Named starter Aug 24 over Sanders. Short leash.

Kirk Cousins.why: Opens as starter with the 1.01 behind him.

Patrick Mahomes.why: Returning from torn ACL/LCL. Practicing, listed questionable.

Micah Parsons.why: PUP to roughly mid-October off a December ACL tear.

Josh Jacobs.why: Has not practiced since Aug 5 and the league has not resolved potential discipline. Availability, not talent, is the projection.

Ashton Jeanty.why: Ankle sprain with an unclear timeline.

Zach Charbonnet.why: PUP after February ACL surgery. Unlikely Week 1.

George Kittle.why: Off PUP ahead of schedule after an Achilles injury.

Tucker Kraft.why: Off PUP and on track for Week 1 after a torn ACL.

Malik Nabers.why: Full-speed drills, trending to Week 1 off a torn ACL.

Ricky Pearsall.why: PCL surgery. Out for the season.

Jayden Higgins.why: Torn ACL. Out for the season.

A.J. Brown.why: Traded to New England. Alpha share in a Drake Maye offense.

Jaylen Waddle.why: Traded to Denver as the clear WR1 over Sutton.

D.J. Moore.why: First real WR1 Josh Allen has had since Diggs.

Mike Evans.why: Signed with San Francisco at 33. Pearsall out, Kirk calf.

Michael Pittman Jr..why: Traded and extended 3yr/$59M as Rodgers' primary target.

Kenneth Walker III.why: Super Bowl LX MVP signed 3yr/$45M as the Chiefs' lead back.

Travis Etienne Jr..why: Signed as New Orleans' lead back.

David Montgomery.why: Traded to Houston to be the early-down and goal-line back.

Isiah Pacheco.why: Signed to take the Montgomery role next to Gibbs. Grade 1 MCL sprain in camp.

Rico Dowdle.why: Signed as Pittsburgh's lead back under McCarthy.

Chig Okonkwo.why: Signed as Daniels' move tight end.

David Njoku.why: Signed into a Mike McDaniel offense.

Isaiah Likely.why: Signed as the Giants' starting tight end under Nagy.

Wan'Dale Robinson.why: Signed as the Titans' slot with Daboll calling plays.

Romeo Doubs.why: 4yr/$68M as New England's WR2 behind A.J. Brown.

Jauan Jennings.why: Signed opposite Jefferson with Kyler Murray at QB.

Kenny Gainwell.why: Signed as Tampa's passing-down back behind Irving.

Tyler Allgeier.why: 2yr/$12.25M as the veteran complement to Love.

Brian Robinson.why: Signed as the short-yardage back behind Bijan.

Jahan Dotson.why: 2yr/$15M as the third option behind London and Pitts.

Hollywood Brown.why: Signed to absorb part of the A.J. Brown vacancy.

Alec Pierce.why: Extended 4yr/$116M but opened camp on PUP after ankle surgery.

Chuba Hubbard.why: Hamstring, week to week, with Brooks ascending.

Cam Skattebo.why: Took the job midseason as a rookie and never gave it back, then missed the last stretch. He has no December sample for the model to read, so the role is asserted: lead back, Tracy in a change-of-pace committee.

qb_depth_2026._doc: Share of the team's dropbacks the Week 1 starter takes IN THE GAMES HE PLAYS. Availability is handled separately by the per-player games projection, so this number should reflect only blowout relief and in-game hooks, not injury risk. An earlier build conflated the two and taxed every quarterback twice.
